en: I shopped for vegetables from the market.
I didn't shop yesterday in the evening.
Did you (m.) shop for meat today?
You (m.) didn't shop for dinner things.
Did you (f.) shop from the big market?
You (f.) didn't shop for dessert yesterday.
He shopped for eggs and milk.
He didn't shop from the supermarket today.
She shopped for vegetables early in the morning.
She didn't shop for the meat for lunch.
We shopped for everything from the shop.
We didn't shop for fish yesterday.
Did you (pl.) shop for the party?
You (pl.) didn't shop for the Eid dried fruit.
They shopped for a lot of goods.
They didn't shop from the weekly market.
I shop every Saturday.
I don't shop in the middle of the week.
Do you (m.) shop from this shop?
You (m.) don't shop for vegetables from here.
You (f.) always shop in the morning.
You (f.) don't shop from this market.
He shops every week for the house.
He doesn't shop from the far market.
She shops for dessert every two days.
She doesn't shop at this time.
We shop every Sunday.
We don't shop from the big supermarket.
Do you (pl.) always shop from here?
You (pl.) don't shop at night.
They shop for goods from Rabat.
They don't shop a lot in Ramadan.

lat: ghadi ntqedda l-khedra ghedda f s-sba7
en: I'm going to shop for vegetables tomorrow morning.

ar: ما غاديش نتقدا اليوم حيت عندي خدمة
en: I'm not going to shop today because I have work.
Are you (m.) going to shop with your brother?

lat: ma ghadich ttqedda mn had l-marchi
ar: ما غاديش تتقدا من هاد المرشي
en: You (m.) are not going to shop from this market.

lat: wach ghadi ttqedday l-7wayj dyal d-dar?
ar: واش غادي تتقداي الحوايج ديال الدار؟
en: Are you (f.) going to shop for things for the house?

lat: ma ghadich ttqedday l-yum f l-3chiya
en: You (f.) are not going to shop today in the afternoon.

ar: غادي يتقدا اللحم من عند الجزار
en: He is going to shop for meat from the butcher.

lat: ma ghadich ytqedda mn s-suq ghedda
ar: ما غاديش يتقدا من السوق غدا
en: He is not going to shop from the market tomorrow.
She is going to shop for dessert for the guests.
She is not going to shop for everything today.
We are going to shop for fish from the port.
We are not going to shop this week.

lat: wach ghadi ttqeddaw l-makla dyal s-sfer?
ar: واش غادي تتقداو الماكلة ديال السفر؟
en: Are you (pl.) going to shop for food for the trip?

lat: ma ghadich ttqeddaw bezzaf had l-merra
ar: ما غاديش تتقداو بزاف هاد المرة
en: You (pl.) are not going to shop a lot this time.
They are going to shop for everything from the market.

lat: ma ghadich ytqeddaw mn l-hanut l-qrib
ar: ما غاديش يتقداو من الحانوت القريب
en: They are not going to shop from the nearby shop.
